stories.headline: Thai Shares May Crack 1,600 Points On Friday
stories.body: (RTTNews) - The Thai stock market has moved higher in two straight sessions, improving more than 25 points or 1.7 percent along the way. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,590-point plateau and it's got a positive lead again for Friday's trade.

stories.headline: Big Banks Launch Tokenized Deposit Network to Fight Off Stablecoin Threat
stories.body: The largest U.S. banks are building their own blockchain payment network, a direct response to crypto firms that are pushing deeper into core banking territory under a crypto-friendly Trump administration. JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Citigroup, Wells Fargo and other major commercial banks plan to launch a tokenized deposit network in the first half

stories.headline: Finastra sells its Phoenix bank core to CORA Group
stories.body: The bank tech provider sold off its U.S. mid-market banking business, including a core used by hundreds of U.S. banks, to a branch of Constellation Software.
